==Description==
'''Lock In''' is a sticker unlocked by reaching Level 25 of the premium track in the [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]]. At that Level, it cost {{Bunz|820}} or {{Robux|110}}. The total cost was {{Bunz|9,810}} or {{Robux|2,070}}.

==Appearance==
The sticker showcases the default [[Minigunner]] trying to hold back laughter.

==Trivia==
*This sticker is a reference to the [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/ishowspeed-smiling-trying-not-to-laugh IShowSpeed Trying Not To Laugh] meme.
**A distorted version of "''Please Speed I need this''" can be heard in this sticker's sound.
